questions.q: What are the three trigger types Data Factory supports?
options: Schedule, Tumbling window, and Event-based
Manual, Automatic, and Scheduled
Copy, Lookup, and Stored Procedure
Pipeline, Dataset, and Linked Service
questions.explain: Schedule triggers run on a wall-clock schedule, Tumbling window triggers run on a periodic interval with retained state, and Event-based triggers respond to events like a file arriving.

questions.q: What does a Schedule trigger's recurrence property configure?
options: The frequency (minute, hour, day, week, month) and interval between runs
Which pipeline parameters get passed at run time
The specific integration runtime used
Whether the trigger is manual or automatic
questions.explain: Recurrence sets how often the trigger fires — for example, frequency 'week' with interval 3 fires every three weeks.

questions.q: What does the optional schedule property add on top of recurrence?
options: Narrows or expands exactly when within the recurrence the trigger fires — specific hours, weekdays, or month days
It's required, not optional, for every Schedule trigger
It replaces recurrence entirely
It only applies to Tumbling window triggers, not Schedule triggers
questions.explain: Schedule adds precision on top of recurrence — for example, restricting a monthly trigger to run only on specific weekdays or the last day of the month.

questions.q: What does monthDays: [-1] mean in a trigger's schedule?
options: The last day of the month, regardless of whether that's the 28th, 30th, or 31st
The first day of the month
The trigger never fires
Exactly one day before the trigger's start date
questions.explain: -1 is a reliable way to target the last day of any month, avoiding the need for separate triggers to handle months of different lengths.

questions.q: Can a single Schedule trigger kick off more than one pipeline?
options: Yes — Schedule triggers support a many-to-many relationship with pipelines
No — each Schedule trigger can only ever target exactly one pipeline
Only if the pipelines share the exact same parameters
Only Tumbling window triggers support multiple pipelines
questions.explain: Unlike a Tumbling window trigger, a Schedule trigger's pipelines array can list multiple pipelines, and a single pipeline can also be triggered by multiple different triggers.
